title: Side-pad kit, Round 5: part list

scheme.variant_order: side L/R, or mirror A/B for flip-handed parts; arm S (drop 22) / L (drop 44); depth D0–D3; angle T0 / T8 / T15
scheme.engraving: short form without GBG-SP-, e.g. 'AR-S-A r5', 0.4 deep on a hidden face
scheme.status_note: Numbering scheme awaiting owner OK (plan 4.16). New in this list: code TS (orange tell sleeve) and EP (epoxy). The plan's LK code is merged into BT, because with latch A the button is the catch (one sliding part).

parts.name: Wing reprint with the 40 mm nose notch

qty.note: chair part: reprinted once, stays on the chair

parts.print: To check with the notch (bridged face, plan 4.9)
dims: the chair's old mount removed: block, pocket and socket, M5 clamp-bolt holes (tip restored to the blade's own 20 mm section)
notch only at z 207–247 (40) on the front edge; mount = tongue centre z 227
tongue pocket d 1.2–17.6 (16.4 wide), from t 6 back to S1: ~10 deep inboard, ~31 outboard
6 mm web to strap slit S1 (z 203–272); walls ≥ 6, back ≥ 8 around the pocket
catch groove in the outer wall: d 17.6–21.4 (2.2 skin), t 9.8–15.2, z 227 ± 7.8, 6° locking face, click entry
parts.function: Takes the kit's nose in a 40 mm notch and holds the tongue and the button's tooth; nothing else on the wing changes.
parts.status_note: part AGREED; print orientation and any local swell OPEN (4.8, 4.9)

parts.name: Carrier: nose + arm + tenon (short S and long L arm)

qty.note: one carrier fitted per side; the full kit has S-A, S-B, L-A, L-B

parts.material: PETG, chair colour + 4 × Ø2 carbon pins (high-Tg epoxy); Ø6 rod removed
parts.print: On its outer face, tree support under the arm bend (v1.1 study); recheck with the button pocket
dims: nose 40 tall (z 207–247) × 29.6 wide (d −6…23.6) × 20 deep (t −14…6), front corner R6, hairline seams 0.3
tongue 16 wide (d 1.4–17.4), into the pocket ~10 (inboard) to ~31 (outboard)
arm 18 × 28 pill, one smooth loft out of the nose's front, plan arc R ≈ 26.6, ends level heading inboard
joint axis 22 (S) or 44 (L) below the mount when LOW (above when flipped HIGH)
tenon 13 × 20 × 13, R2.5; 4 × Ø2 pin holes at (±3.5, ±7.4), 8 into the arm
Ø6.5 teardrop bore (peak up) at d 9.4, z c − 10, tongue rear face → t ≈ −29
button pocket 12 × 24 stadium on the nose's outer face; max x ≤ 165
parts.function: Carries the pad: the nose completes the wing, the arm sets the height, the tenon takes the depth piece.
parts.status_note: part and both lengths AGREED; A/B mirror under the flip and print orientation OPEN (4.10); corner-knock SF < 1 OPEN (4.11)

parts.name: Button-catch (latch A: the button is the catch)
variants: one part for A and B (to confirm with the flip, 4.7/4.10)
parts.print: Standing, 24 along z (crisp face; fig2); recheck with the tooth
dims: face 12 (t) × 24 (z) stadium, R6 ends, flat and square to the push, 0.8 thumb scoop, 0.4 edge chamfer, gap 0.3
centred t −2.5, z 227 on the nose's outer face (d 23.6)
travel 5 inboard (−d) to a hard stop
tooth d 17.4 → 21.1 (3.5 engaged), t 10–15, z c ± 7.5: to be upsized for the ~900 N corner knock
6° tapered locking face (no rattle), sharp-edged click entry
parts.function: One sliding part: press it in and the tooth leaves the wing's groove; let go and the spring pushes it out into the groove.
parts.status_note: form and latch A AGREED; tooth size and 6° face with the flip OPEN (CAD + coupon 5.5); replaces the plan's LK row

parts.name: Orange tell sleeve (not-latched ring)

qty.note: one per carrier, around the button

dims: stadium ring around the 12 × 24 button, 0.6 wall
hidden 0.6 below the face when latched; shows as an orange ring when the button is held in (not latched)
parts.function: Status: flush and quiet = latched; orange ring visible = not latched.
parts.status_note: function AGREED; separate sleeve vs 2-colour button and the new code TS are RECOMMENDED

parts.name: Latch spring
dims: OD 6, wire 0.55, free length 16, 9 coils
~4 N at rest, ~8 N pressed
sits along d, seat d 2.5 → d 10
parts.function: Pushes the button-catch out; the latch holds by its shape, not by the spring.
parts.status_note: spec as plan 7.5; rate check on a kitchen scale (5.7)

parts.name: Steel dowel tooth (optional)

qty.note: only if the coupon picks the steel tooth

dims: diameter and length set on the latch coupon (5.5–5.6)
pressed into the button-catch as its tooth
parts.function: Optional steel tooth for the latch if the printed tooth is too weak.
parts.status_note: AGREED as a coupon option; size and use OPEN

parts.name: Carbon rod Ø6, arm
variants: one length for S and L (to confirm in CAD)
parts.print: Cut on gauge v2, Ø6 lane
dims: Ø6 in a Ø6.5 teardrop bore, peak up
from the tongue's rear face to t ≈ −29: ≈ 55 long (estimate, final in CAD, 4.14)
parts.function: Stiffens the arm root across the wing mouth (arm SF 1.20 → 1.50 at a 300 N knock).

parts.name: Carbon tenon pins Ø2 × 21
parts.print: Cut on gauge v2, Ø2 lane
dims: Ø2 × 21: 13 in the tenon + 8 into the arm
at (±3.5, ±7.4) about the joint axis
parts.function: Pins the tenon to the arm across its root (about 2× the tenon-root capacity).

parts.name: Depth piece, straight foot (T0)

qty.note: 2 of the chosen depth; full kit 2 × D0–D3

parts.print: Joint end down (v1.1); recheck with the dovetail
dims: sleeve face (x 128.1) to pad back: 24.1 / 36.1 / 48.1 / 60.1
18 × 28 pill sleeve (same skin as the arm, hairline 0.3) flaring over 18 into a 27 × 40 foot, R14.5
hollow 13.4 × 20.4 for the tenon, stepping to 11 × 18 at the tenon tip (hidden step)
foot: front-to-back dovetail with a closed front stop (replaces the 20 × 3.5 key); floor 6
M5×12 countersunk from the back face into the tenon nut; M5×10 button head to the pad inside the hollow
parts.function: Sets how far in the pad sits (4 depths, 12 apart) and carries the pad on a dovetail.
parts.status_note: D0–D3 AGREED; tenon-tip step and dovetail RECOMMENDED (2.24)

parts.name: Depth piece, tilted foot (8° and 15°)

qty.note: a full tilt set per depth: 2 × T0 + T8A + T8B + T15A + T15B

parts.print: Joint end down, as T0; engraved use label, e.g. 'DP-D2-T15A · L+15 / R−15'
dims: foot face turned θ about the foot centre on the pad back; pad centre does not move
contact point moves ∓4.8 at 8°, ∓8.9 at 15° (re-check the armpit gap)
D0 at 15°: tenon tip to tilted floor 2.4 (3.7 at 8°), keep ≥ 2
parts.function: Tilts the pad top in or out; one print per angle, not flippable.

parts.name: Pad shell (2 screw positions, dovetail, cover groove)
variants: L, R (or one part if it stays symmetric in z)
parts.print: Child side down, tree supports on the hidden side
dims: 82 (y −27…55) × 80 tall, shell 4.5, plain curved plate (front edge curves ~7.5 toward the child)
two boss + nut positions at ± 11 about the pad centre, both hidden under the foot (boss R7)
dovetail socket under the foot (27 × 40 footprint), closed front
cover groove in the back face 3.2–8.8 in from the edge, 2.5 deep
parts.function: The pad's stiff back; the screw position picks ± 11 of height.
parts.status_note: AGREED; dovetail RECOMMENDED (2.24); L/R vs one part OPEN

parts.name: Clip ring with snap retention
parts.print: Flat and bent in, or supported (plan 4.13)
dims: closed loop at mid-groove (~6 in from the pad edge), 1.6 thick, 2.5 tall
groove 5.6 = ring 1.6 + 2 × 2 neoprene
positive retention: snap lip or undercut, stays flush
parts.function: Traps the cover's edge in the back groove: no sewing, cannot work loose.
parts.status_note: retention AGREED; form (lip vs undercut) and print method OPEN (4.13)

parts.name: Foam cushion 30 mm
variants: one thickness (FS reference); README's 17 / 30 / 43 per depth to confirm
dims: pad outline 82 × 80, 30 thick
child-side rim rounded ~R10
parts.function: Soft contact with the child's side.
parts.status_note: 30 mm in the brief and the FS; per-depth thickness (plan §8 row) OPEN

parts.name: Cover (no-sew)
dims: ≈ 170 × 165 blank (pad + 2 × (foam 30 + shell 4.5 + wrap ~8)), trim on the pad coupon
wraps foam and shell edge into the back groove under the ring
parts.function: Washable, wipe-clean skin held only by the clip ring.
parts.status_note: AGREED; wrap and pattern size to review on the pad coupon (5.8)

parts.name: Tenon screw M5×12 countersunk + M5 nut
parts.material: Steel, from stock (ISO 10642; nut DIN 934 / ISO 4032)
dims: head Ø10, flush in the depth piece's back face
nut in a 5.1 deep pocket inside the tenon
parts.function: Locks the depth piece on the tenon; plastic takes the load (hidden step).

parts.name: Pad screw M5×10 button head + M5 nut
dims: from inside the depth piece's hollow into a nut in the pad boss
parts.function: Locks the pad on the dovetail; the closed front stop takes the load.

parts.name: Blank cap for the notch (kit off)

qty.note: optional: owner to confirm cap vs no cap (4.6)

dims: matches the nose: 40 tall × 29.6 × 20, front corner R6, flush, hairlines 0.3
short tongue into the same pocket; retention detail OPEN
parts.function: Closes the 40 mm notch so the wing looks whole when the kit is off.

parts.name: High-Tg epoxy
dims: bonds CF6 and the 4 × CF2 pins
parts.function: Keeps the carbon bonded in a hot car.

parts.name: Rod cutting gauge v2 (tool)
dims: Ø8 lane (headrest H0–H100), Ø6 lane (arm rod), Ø2 lane (pins 21)
accuracy ±0.3
parts.function: Cuts every carbon length right first time.

child_set.title: Example: a 2-year-old (P50, sitting armpit z ≈ 268), both sides
child_set.setting: H2: short arm, LOW, lower pad-screw hole → pad centre z 194, pad top 234 (34 below the armpit)

items.note: depth chosen at the fitting; D1 shown
only if the cap is confirmed (4.6)

child_set.growth: H3 (~3 y): same parts, move the pad screw to the upper hole. H4–H5 (~4–5 y): swap the two short carriers left↔right (flip to HIGH). Only H1 (smallest) and H6 (5y P95) need the long carriers.
